coverage.evidence: dashboard/src/views/dashboard/commands/CommandsView.vue:58-63 puts the System commands tab behind read: 'commands:write', and server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Content/Identity/ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:180 gives that action to Mod by default. BuiltinList.vue:94-127 shows the Built-in commands title, the Search commands box (i18n en.json dashboard.commands.list.search), rows sorted A to Z with a switch except for always-on commands, and Using the default / Overrides the default ({value}) / Always on / the reserved line. BuiltinEditor.vue:105-121 makes Customize show until there is an override (cooldowns, role, replyOverrideCount, speakWithTts). Lines 123-140 count unsaved changes (settings count as one, each reply as one, TTS as one), 206-219 make Back to default save at once, 222-235 hold the reset consequences, 237-247 the reset, 289-291 Discard, 334 maxlength 500 and 501-543 the footer buttons. i18n en.json holds the dialog title, body and item labels exactly as quoted. BuiltinCommandService.cs:29 and 208-215 set the 0 to 3600 limit, and 227-231 refuse lowering the role below the default.

DependencyInjection.cs:1307-1369 registers 43 IBuiltinCommand classes, and the trigger keys match BuiltinResponseSlots*.cs and the BuiltinKey literals. Every default cooldown, per-person cooldown and level in the table matches the class literals (for example AllowBuiltin 3s/20, WhisperBuiltin 0/12/10, PlayBuiltin 0/10, WhitelistBuiltins BroadcasterLevel 40, CommandsBuiltin 120, LeaderboardBuiltin 90, QuoteBuiltin 45). PermissionLevel.cs:20-30 together with PermissionLevelNames gives 10 = Moderator, 20 = LeadModerator and 40 = Broadcaster. The music commands default to level 0, and MusicModerationGate.cs:30-55 checks a moderator or the music:queue:moderate grant. MusicBuiltins.cs:41 and 74-103 add the 30s moderator-skip window, and 517-518 let anyone read the volume while setting it is gated. PermitBuiltins.cs:256-259 make permit always on at level 10 behind permit:issue, ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:214 sets permit:issue to Broadcaster with an Editor floor, and PermitBuiltins.cs:399 lets a moderator use a bare reply !permit. WhisperCommandHandler.cs:40-69 and 109-135 cover the whisper path, and WhisperSafe is set at UptimeBuiltin.cs:45 and MusicBuiltins.cs:337 and 625. OfflineCommandGate.cs exempts the broadcaster and moderators, and ChatMessageHandler.cs:299 exempts reserved commands. ChatMessageHandler.cs:318 ignores a disabled command silently.

server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Chat/EventHandlers/ChatMessageHandler.cs:200-202 and 304-312: a resolved authored command answers unless the built-in IsAlwaysOn. IBuiltinCommand.IsAlwaysOn defaults to IsReserved (true for forgetme, mydata and gdpr in GdprBuiltins.cs), and permit and unpermit set IsAlwaysOn true (PermitBuiltins.cs:257 and 499 area), so only those five keep precedence. BuiltinCommandService.cs:279-299 ResetAsync sets IsEnabled = true and OverridesJson = null on the command's own row, and clears only the replies on a row sharing its reply group. BuiltinResponseSlots.cs:33-36 pairs unlurk with lurk and profile with stats. BuiltinCommandService.cs:103-125 refuses toggling a reserved or always-on command and runs the binding guard on disable. The binding sources are rewards, chat triggers, timers, event responses, catalog items and giveaways; ScheduledTaskBindingUsageSource.cs:30-31 never matches a built-in key.

reader_answers.evidence: BuiltinList.vue:117 opens the editor from a row. BuiltinEditor.vue:514-523 shows Customize while the command is not customized, 337 keeps the reply box disabled until it is editable, and 534-541 Save changes calls save() at 254-287, which sends the changed replies.

CommandsView.vue:58-63 gates the tab on commands:write, and ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:180 gives it to Mod, so moderator and every rung above. BuiltinEditor.vue:118-119 locks reserved commands, and BuiltinCommandService.cs:202-206 refuses changes to them.

BuiltinEditor.vue:296-300 empties the unsaved count once nothing differs from the saved values. Lines 361, 387, 418, 449 and 478 show Back to default only for a saved override. BuiltinList.vue:68-87 shows Overrides the default only when the role or a cooldown override exists, otherwise Using the default.

ChatMessageHandler.cs:311-312 lets a same-named authored command answer instead of the built-in unless the built-in is always on (permit, unpermit, reserved data-rights). Deleting the channel command lets the fallback built-in path at 314-418 run. BuiltinReplyService.cs:380-395 together with BuiltinEditor.vue:119 and 337 keeps data-rights replies uneditable.
